x: For Belgrave, as the Israeli Ladany speeds across Westminster Bridge at 8 minute mile speed, Ray Middleton new to the distance but likely to set a new club record beating Ray Hall's 7Hrs 58 Mins 33 Secs.

A fine walk by Ray Middleton who finished second to the Israeli Ladany and also a sub 6 Hour clocking from Dave DeBondi, certainly his finest race in this country, gave Belgrave an easy team victory over Surrey Walking Club.
